pr_title: builtins: fix memory accounting of `st_collect` and `st_makeline` aggregates
pr_body:
This commit tightens the memory accounting done by the `stCollectAgg`. This aggregate is special because it can append an arbitrary number of `geom.T` objects, and previously we didn't account for each of them as best as we could nor did we account for the overhead of the large backing slice inside of the GeometryCollection.

It also fixes the memory accounting done by the `stMakeLineAgg`. In particular, previously we only accounted for the length rather than capacity of the `float64` slice. We also incorrectly were emptying the account on `Reset` even though we're keeping the reference to the underlying slice.

These bugs seem like edge cases, so I decided to not include the release note.

Fixes: #109116.

Release note: None
